diag.txt: Sell and replace: 1 wallet received SOL from a dev / bundle / early-buyer sale and then bought this coin — the same money back in under new wallets; they hold 0.0% now.
Launch check: our tracker saw 15.1% bought in the create block by 3 wallets; this lookup found 26.0% by 4 — more than the tracker (it may have missed a transaction live).
GMGN tags 38 holders as bundler or insider; 0 of them are also in our bundle / owner groups.
Bundles: GMGN says bundlers bought 0.1% and hold 21.5% now; we measure 29.4% bought together and 0.0% still held.
Selling: the early wallets have sold 52.3% of supply so far, 0.0% of it in the last hour (1 wallet); 1 sold in the last 30 min.
9 of the early wallets are trading in and out of the coin (3+ buys and 3+ sells) — volume farming or flipping.
The dev and bundle's group (6 wallets including wallets linked to them) holds 0.0% now.
Dev made no buy at launch; his wallet holds 0.0% now.
Bundle wallets: took 26.0% in the create block, hold 0.0% now; 4 of 4 sold out.
The first 60 buyers after the dev and bundle (all within 9 s of launch) bought 54.2%; together with the dev and bundle 0 wallets still hold 0.0%. Fresh: 2 of 64 checked, holding 0.0%.
The early wallets sent tokens to 4 other wallets; they hold nothing now (sold or passed on).
28 of the early wallets are whales (50+ SOL or $10K+ in tokens), holding 0.0% now.
Snipers (4 blocks after the create): 5 took 7.3%, hold 0.0% now.
Top 10 holders (pool and curve left out) hold 14.8%; the largest 2.2%.
The bundle's first sales were at about $15K–$58K market cap (today's SOL price).
No other coins from this dev wallet.
50 funders are busy, exchange-like wallets; wallets that share only that funder were not grouped together.
